description: This file contains functions for merging binary blobs and handling file merge operations within a version control system, including reading objects, merging three-way file versions, and managing memory associated with file buffers.

methods.name: int fill_mmfile_blob(mmfile_t * f,struct blob * obj)
methods.description: Reads a blob object from the repository and fills an mmfile_t structure with its contents if the object is of type OBJ_BLOB.

methods.name: void free_mmfile(mmfile_t * f)
methods.description: Frees the memory buffer associated with an mmfile_t structure.

methods.name: void * three_way_filemerge(struct index_state * istate,const char * path,mmfile_t * base,mmfile_t * our,mmfile_t * their,unsigned long * size)
methods.description: Performs a three-way merge of files at different versions and returns the merged content, handling binary conflicts.

methods.name: void * merge_blobs(struct index_state * istate,const char * path,struct blob * base,struct blob * our,struct blob * their,unsigned long * size)
methods.description: Performs a merge of blob objects considering their base, ours, and theirs versions, returning the merged result or NULL on conflict.

ctags.signature: (struct index_state * istate,const char * path,struct blob * base,struct blob * our,struct blob * their,unsigned long * size)
